name: MoYu AoLong 3x3 V6 (Magnetic, UV Coated)
description: The MoYu AoLong 3x3 V6 (Magnetic, UV Coated) pairs a lightweight carbon fiber core with a high-grip UV coated finish and dual 8-level tuning, so you can dial in exactly the control-to-speed balance you want. A 48-magnet setup with spring tension keeps the turning accurate and snappy without stepping up to the MagLev tiers.
features: High-grip UV coated finish: A super glossy, wear-resistant surface that adds grip and holds up to long solve sessions.
Accurate magnetic turning: 48 magnets give the cube a clean, positive click into place on every turn.
Tune it your way: Dual 8-level tuning unlocks 64 feel configurations, so you can match the cube to how you actually solve.
Light and stable: The carbon fiber core keeps weight down while locking the structure in at speed.
8-level spring elasticity: The spring adjusts across eight distinct, precise mechanical levels.
8-level tension: Set the balance between looseness and tightness for your preferred corner-cutting, control and stability.
